set.rappels: 2 rappels on a single 60 m rope from an anchor near a tree at the north end of the East Face (full rope-stretchers)
set.rappel_count_note: Two rappels on a single 60 m rope reach the ground. Both are close to the rope's length, so tie stopper knots in the ends.
set.descent_text: From the top, move to the rappel anchor near a tree at the north end of the formation. With a single 60m rope, two rappels down bolted anchors return climbers to the base. Tie stopper knots in the rope ends — the rappels can otherwise run the ends off the rock.

review.single_rope: Two rappels on a single 60 m rope from the north end of the East Face; trip reports note the long single-rappel option tends to snag, so parties choose the two-rappel line.
review.changed: Removed the aside about a long single rappel on tied ropes from rappels, note and descent_text; kept the existing 2-station single-rope table (both 30 m).

set.rappels: 2 rappels on a single 60 m rope from a tree-anchored station at the north end of the East Face
set.rappel_count_note: Cobbles 101 finishes on the Bowling Alley, so the descent is the same: two rappels on a single 60 m rope reach the ground. Both are close to the rope's length, so tie stopper knots in the ends.
set.descent_text: From the top, move to the rappel anchor near a tree at the north end of the formation. With a single 60m rope, two rappels down bolted anchors return climbers to the base. Tie stopper knots in the rope ends — the rappels can otherwise run the ends off the rock.

review.single_rope: Same descent as Bowling Alley: two rappels on a single 60 m rope from the north end of the East Face. No separate descent page for Cobbles 101 itself.
review.changed: Removed the aside about a long single rappel on tied ropes; kept the existing 2-station single-rope table.

set.rappels: Rappel the line of ascent on its fixed Fixe chain anchors, one rappel per belay (14 pitches); some stretches are a full 60 m
set.rappel_count_note: The descent is the line of ascent, one rappel per belay, and no total is published. Some of these rappels are a full 60 m, so one 60 m rope does not reach between those belays, and no intermediate anchors are known. Where a belay is more than 30 m below the one above, one rope cannot reach it; a party on a single rope should expect to need a 70 m rope or to stop at any anchor that is within half a rope. The upper pitches share anchors with Primal Scream.
set.descent_text: Rappel the line of ascent on fixed chain/bolt anchors; parties typically rappel to the Pitch 13 chain anchor near the summit before continuing down.

review.single_rope: No source documents a single-rope line. Sources say the descent follows the route with some rappels a full 60 m; no per-station lengths or intermediate anchors were found.
review.changed: Cleared the 14-row table (every row was written for a long-rope setup with no lengths) and removed the carry-extra-rope wording; stated plainly what one rope does and does not reach.

set.rappels: 5 rappels down the line of ascent, one per pitch, from bolted Fixe chain anchors
set.rappel_count_note: One rappel per pitch from the bolted chain belays. Rappel lengths are not published, so it is not documented whether a single 60 m rope reaches each belay, and no intermediate anchors are known. Judge each rappel against the pitch length you climbed: one 60 m rope reaches only about 30 m.
set.descent_text: Rappel the line of ascent using the fixed hand-drilled bolt and Fixe chain anchors.

review.single_rope: Nothing found on a single-rope descent; the only documented descent is rappelling the route off chain anchors. No page for this route could be found.
review.changed: Cleared the 5-row table written for a long-rope setup; removed the long-rope recommendation from rappels, note and descent_text; stated what is unknown for one rope.

set.rappels: Rappel the line of ascent on the 2023 bolted anchors, one rappel per belay (12 pitches); the upper three share anchors with Concerto in C for Drill and Hammer
set.rappel_count_note: The descent is the line of ascent, one rappel per belay, and no total is published. The upper three pitches share anchors with Concerto in C for Drill and Hammer, where some rappels are a full 60 m, which one 60 m rope does not reach. set.descent_text: Rappel the line of ascent using the 2023-installed modern bolted anchors; the upper three pitches share anchors with Concerto in C for Drill and Hammer.

set.descent_text: Rappel the line of ascent, one rappel per pitch. The belays are close to 50 m apart, which is beyond what one 60 m rope reaches, and no intermediate anchors are known.
